column12: Verbosity of the shared library's own output in starsector.log, separate from each mod's own setting - a mod's verbosity governs that mod's lines, this one governs the library code beneath them. WARN is the normal level; DEBUG adds the diagnostics from the probes that read the game's UI by reflection, which is what says why one of them is not answering. Default: WARN.
